summary: Operator and Newbook booking page: confirmed 185 paved sites (pull-throughs to 80+ ft), reservable online; added laundry, Wi-Fi, booking URL and the seasonal booking pattern. Fees left as human-read (see flag). Note trimmed of the rates. Not stated: hookups, season, rig limit.
flags: Long-stay test 3 (minimum over 2 nights) fails in season: for November and January arrivals the booking page sells only 90- to 180-night terms ('90 Night min'); single 'Summer Daily' nights appear only for summer/early-autumn arrivals (2026-10-27, 2027-06-08). Fort Myers family-proximity exception covers price only. Roots' page also carries 'Available Homes', 'Submit a Community Application' and 'Move Your Home to Our Community' links (Roots-wide template; no homes were listed for this park on the pages read).

Fees: recorded $57.55-63.57 (human read 2026-10-10).
